🇨🇳 Surge in HMPV 🦠 Infections Among Teenagers in China 
 
China is witnessing a sharp rise in Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) infections 🦠, particularly among 14-year-olds, fueled by cold temperatures. The virus, which causes symptoms similar to the flu or COVID-19, is spreading rapidly in schools and crowded areas. 
 
Despite growing concerns, no vaccine is currently available for HMPV, leaving prevention measures like masks and hygiene as the only defenses. Hospitals are struggling to manage the surge, while global health experts warn of its potential to spread further
